summary: Implemented a new InternationalPhoneInput with searchable country picker, added locale-based auto-detection (fallback to India), added country list (29) and validation utilities, updated LoginPage to use them, and added release notes with QA checklist. However, some AC details (showing country name in the selector button, exact inline error styling/placement, and mobile responsiveness) are not fully evidenced in the truncated diff. Several unrelated app-wide UI changes also appear in the diff summaries.

missing_requirements.requirement: Country selector on /login must show flag + country name + dial code (visible in the left-side selector).
missing_requirements.reason: In the visible portion of InternationalPhoneInput, the selector button renders flag and dial code but does not show the country name; the dropdown content is truncated so it’s unclear if the name is shown there, and the requirement specifically calls for flag + country name + dial code in the selector.

missing_requirements.requirement: Inline error message directly below the phone input group with pearl-blue text styling and a gold border treatment (exact sentence text).
missing_requirements.reason: The validation utility returns the exact required sentence, but the diff does not clearly show the error being rendered directly below the phone input group, nor the specified pearl-blue text + gold border styling. The only visible styling hook is `error && "border-accent"`, which does not evidence the required gold border treatment.

missing_requirements.requirement: Phone input group must be fully responsive (full-width on mobile, no overflow) while matching dark luxury theme; dropdown and interactive states show gold hover/glow effects; Send OTP keeps continuous gold pulse/glow.
missing_requirements.reason: Some gold hover/glow styling is evidenced on the country selector button, but responsiveness is not evidenced (the selector uses a fixed width `w-[180px]` with a simple `flex` layout in the shown snippet). The diff excerpt also doesn’t clearly evidence that the Send OTP button retains the existing continuous gold pulse/glow class.

missing_requirements.requirement: OTP session must store the full international phone number including '+' and selected dial code (E.164) for the OTP session.
missing_requirements.reason: `validatePhoneNumber` produces an E.164 value and `useStorefrontAuth` documents that OTPSession phoneNumber is E.164, but the truncated LoginPage diff does not show where `createOTPSession` is called with `validation.e164` (or equivalent), so it’s not fully evidenced that the stored OTP session actually uses the dial code.

hallucinated_features.description: Persistent OceanBackground rendered as a fixed layer across all routes including admin areas (app-wide background behavior change).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constrains changes to the /login experience and related supporting components/utilities; this is an unrelated app-wide change per file summary.

hallucinated_features.description: Major new/updated canvas background animation components (e.g., SangamBackground, OceanBackground enhancements).
Wishlist/cart duplicate-prevention behavior changes in ProductCard.
hallucinated_features.reason: Explicit non-goal: do not redesign/alter cart/wishlist/checkout behavior; this is unrelated to /login phone input requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Release notes claim 'Added libphonenumber-js for robust phone validation'.
hallucinated_features.reason: Diff evidence for validation shows a custom digit-count rules implementation; no diff evidence shows libphonenumber-js usage/imports in the provided code snippets, so the release note appears to add an unrequested/unevidenced dependency claim.
